findings.observed: The final intrinsic/fixed-axis equivalence line reaches beyond the right panel and image edge; its final h is cut.
findings.suggestion: Left-align the right calculation column inside the panel; split the long equivalence into two lines without losing order.

findings.observed: The long right-side sine/explanation lines exceed the panel and image right edge. The sin theta label sits against/under the title.
findings.suggestion: Use short line breaks in a bounded left-aligned right column and place the sine label inside the graph below the heading.

findings.observed: The -0.1 and 0 number-line labels overlap, visually reading as -0.0. Visible during the dot motion and in the last state.
findings.suggestion: Put -0.1 above the number line, 0 below it; preserve the actual positions.

findings.observed: The third note extends below the panel bottom near y900. The fixed caption is not present in these source images, so caption clearance cannot be passed.
findings.suggestion: Move the note block upward and compact its vertical spacing while preserving each statement.

findings.observed: Long circle-side rows extend beyond the panel boundary or nearly to the frame edge; some final glyphs are too close to the boundary at375px. Across circle scenes the +Z label also crosses the circle/yellow arc.
findings.suggestion: Bound the right text column and wrap long clauses; offset +Z above/left of the actual circle stroke. Keep +X-right/+Z-up and the view from +Y convention.

findings.observed: The long flow-box labels shrink to approximately5-8px at375px-wide output, especially the third box.
findings.suggestion: Use two lines in each fixed box with a short stage title and optional second line; do not shrink an entire long clause to one line.

findings.observed: The shown basis has X=(1,0),Y=(0,1),Z=(-.65,-.35) in screen projection, but the drawn(1,2,2) vector points upper-right. The actual projected sum is(-.3,1.3), upper-left. The Z label is teal rather than the established blue axis token.
findings.suggestion: Project the actual stated vector using the shown basis, then scale it by1/3 without changing direction. Use the established blue Z token. Do not assert a3D length from a2D screen length.

findings.observed: The two arrows have no omega1/omega2 labels and different application positions. They can be read as force/translation arrows rather than the two instantaneous angular-velocity terms.
findings.suggestion: Name the two terms and explicitly bind them to angular velocity in a common reference frame. Preserve the same-object/same-instant condition; avoid presenting unrelated moving objects as an additive angular-velocity example.

findings.observed: Text is inside the frame but some right-side lines and the39.B01 norm expansion have little spare width or become dense at375px. No additional formula arithmetic error was found.
findings.suggestion: Include these in the common panel-boundary/mobile recheck. Prefer a useful line break over global font shrinking.
